# AI Book Shelf / AI 书架

A persistent DSH Web UI plugin that adds a full-page multi-format reader to the
sidebar, an AI expla

nation rail for selected text, a paper library with
translation and bilingual comparison, and a doss

ier library with searchable
files and AI summaries.
## Highlights

- **Read many formats** — EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, FB2 and DOCX.
- **Ask without leaving the

page** — select text for background, context,
explanations and follow-ups in the right rail.
- **Sea

rch the whole shelf** — full-book `Ctrl+F`, online book search (Project
Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks,

Chinese Wikimedia sources) and custom OPDS sources.
- **Paper mode** — paragraph/whole-paper transla

tion, bilingual comparison, AI
explanations and follow-ups.
- **Dossier mode** — folders, Ctrl+A mul

ti-import, keyword search, AI summaries
of results, and per-folder skills.
## Install

1. Download `dsh-ai-book-shelf-2.7.2.tgz` from the
latest release,
or install from npm with `dsh-ai-

book-shelf@2.7.2`.
2. In DSH open **Plugins → Add plugin** and choose the downloaded tgz, or paste
t

he npm package spec.
3. Reload the plugin and open **AI 书架 / AI Book Shelf** in the sidebar.

Chinese step-by-step guide: INSTALL-zh.md. Publishing and npm
instructions: PUBLISHING.md.
## What it does

- **Shelf** — scans the archive shelf (the first registered workspace by
default, which is `D:\BookL

ib` on this deployment), plus any extra
`libraryDirs`, for supported book files.
- **Copies external

books** — a book opened or imported from outside the
archive shelf is copied into `archiveDir` firs

t. Identical files are reused;
a name collision gets a ` (2)` suffix rather than overwriting anythin

g.
- **Dossier mode** — a separate dossier library with folders, multi-select
import (Ctrl/Cmd or Ct

rl+A in the file picker), folder-scoped full-text
search, streamed AI summaries, and folder skills.

Creating a folder adds an
empty skill you can fill in; an imported `SKILL.md` can replace it, and AI

summaries follow it.
- **Public-domain search** — the **Search books** tab queries Project Gutenber

g
(Gutendex, with the Gutenberg website search as a fallback), a Chinese-only
Project Gutenberg cata

log (`lang=zh`), Chinese Wikisource, Chinese Wikibooks,
and Standard Ebooks, then saves the chosen b

ook (EPUB, or an HTML book for
the Wikimedia sources) into the archive shelf. Simplified Chinese que

ries are
also tried as traditional Chinese for the Chinese catalogs. Results stream
into the page on

e source at a time; slower sources keep searching while the
first results are already usable. The se

arch store lives outside the Library
component, so opening a book or switching Harness pages does no

t abort the
stream; returning restores the query and results, and the Host keeps result
ids download

able for 30 minutes. Only
public-domain / openly licensed catalogs are used; DRM and unauthorized bo

ok
sources are not supported. Choose which catalogs to query with **Choose
sources**; the selected s

ource homepages are shown as small links. A custom
**OPDS** search URL can be added, but only entrie

s that declare an
`open-access` EPUB acquisition link are accepted. Several custom OPDS sources
can

be added with the **+** button. The built-in Chinese catalogs cover
traditional Chinese Gutenberg ti

tles and Wikisource; other catalogs are
mostly English.
- **Reader** — parses the book into chapters

, sanitizes HTML, and renders a
[该节后续省略]
## Supported formats
| Format | Support |

| `.epub` | Full spine, chapters, TOC, images, cover |
| `.pdf` | Text-layer extraction, 8 pages per

chapter; scanned PDFs need OCR first |
| `.txt` / `.text` | Plain text, automatically chunked |
| `

.md` / `.markdown` | Headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code blocks |
| `.html` / `.htm` / `.xhtml

` | Sanitized HTML body |
| `.fb2` | FictionBook XML |
| `.docx` | Word paragraphs and Heading 1–3 c

hapters |
| `.mobi` / `.azw3` / `.azw` | Convert to EPUB or PDF first (for example with Calibre) |

PDF extraction uses a vendored PDF.js runtime under `vendor/pdfjs/`; the package
has no npm runtime

s a vendored PDF.js runtime under `vendor/pdfjs/`; the package
has no npm runtime dependency for it.
## Configuration

Edit the installed row's config in the profile patch (or the plugin's
`cordis.patch.yml` before inst

installed row's config in the profile patch (or the plugin's
`cordis.patch.yml` before installing):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The Host routes are mounted under `/api/epub-reader`. They accept only
same-origin browser requests,

expose only `.epub` files found under a configured
shelf root, copy external files into the archive

before parsing, and stream
explanations over SSE.
## Notes

- Books are opened read-only; progress is stored in the browser's `localStorage`.
- DRM-protected bo

oks are not supported.
- PDF support is text-first: a scanned/image-only PDF returns `PDF_NO_TEXT`
i

nstead of showing blank pages. Run OCR or convert it to a text PDF first.
- MOBI/AZW3 are not parsed

directly; convert them to EPUB/PDF before importing.
- The plugin uses the official `llm` Host serv

ice; no API key is read by the
plugin itself.
- Only the first 5 opened books are retained in memory

; a re-open re-parses the
file.
- Annotation history is stored in `<archiveDir>/.epub-reader/annotat

ions.json`
and keyed by the EPUB content fingerprint, so the same book keeps its records
even at a d

ifferent path. Copy that folder with the EPUB when moving a shelf
to another machine if the annotati

ons should travel with it.
- Search results are cached for 30 minutes so a result can be downloaded;

a
stale id returns `SEARCH_EXPIRED` and the UI asks you to search again.
- Clearing the search fiel

d (the browser's X) or pressing **Stop searching**
aborts the in-flight request instead of leaving t

he spinner running.
- Custom OPDS sources must be lawful/open-access catalogs. The Host only accepts

EPUB acquisition links marked `open-access`; it is not a generic downloader.
- Downloads are bounde

d to 120 MB and fetched only from allow-listed
`gutenberg.org` / `standardebooks.org` hosts. Large b

ooks can take a while.
- The search feature needs outbound network access from the DSH Host process.
